svg.text: SBU: seven drones sank corvette Merkury; cargo ship Angara also hit.
Seven drones launched from a “mothership”, SBU says;
Zelenskyy releases “exemplary” footage; Libya’s Tripoli government protests.
Russian strikes kill at least 15 in the Kyiv region;
a boy, 7, is pulled alive from a collapsed block of flats at Dymer.
